tool_calls.name: run_python
tool_calls.code:
import pandas as pd
u = pd.read_csv('utilization.csv')
c = pd.read_csv('instance_catalog.csv')
row = u[u.instance_id=='i-d36dd27144c2'].iloc[0]
cur = row.instance_type
curinfo = c[c.instance_type==cur].iloc[0]
req_v = curinfo.vcpu * row.p95_cpu_pct/100 / 0.7
req_m = curinfo.memory_gib * row.p95_mem_pct/100 / 0.8
print(cur, curinfo.vcpu, curinfo.memory_gib, req_v, req_m)
fam = c[c.family==curinfo.family]
cand = fam[(fam.vcpu>=req_v)&(fam.memory_gib>=req_m)].sort_values('hourly_usd')
print(cand)
